Enter the code in the notification to complete pairing.
The pairing process needs you to interact with a notification from OmniShizuku. Please allow OmniShizuku to post notifications.
MIUI users may need to switch notification style to "Android" from "Notification" - "Notification shade" in system settings.
Otherwise, you may not able to enter paring code from the notification.
Please note, left part of the "Wireless debugging" option is clickable, tapping it will open a new page. Only turing on the switch on the right is incorrect.
Back to OmniShizuku and start OmniShizuku.
OmniShizuku needs to access local network. It is controlled by the network permission.

Some systems (such as MIUI) disallow apps to access the network when they are not visible, even if the app uses foreground service as standard. Please disable battery optimization features for OmniShizuku on such systems.

In addition, OmniShizuku can be started automatically on boot. If not, please check if your system or third-party tools have restricted OmniShizuku.

Automatic pairing reads the code out of the system dialog through Shizuku's accessibility service, so it has to be enabled, and only for as long as it takes: the service turns itself off once the code is found, or after a minute to save power. Shizuku normally enables it on its own, and that needs the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission, which a fresh install has not been granted yet.

Enable it on the next screen, type the code yourself under Manual, or grant the permission once:

adb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

Samsung keeps these in the battery service data, and prints them in the battery dump. They are not part of the Android API, so another make will not have them.

Counters kept by the platform itself. They reset every time the battery is charged to full, which is why a phone charged an hour ago reads seconds here and one that has been off the charger all day reads hours.
Attributed by component, which is what this platform prints. It keeps per-app figures as wake locks and running times instead of as milliamp hours, so no per-app numbers are invented here.

The platform does not report the design capacity, and this device denies the fuel gauge even to the shell, so no percentage of a full battery can be calculated honestly. What the system has learned is above.

Every thermal sensor the kernel exposes, hottest first. A sensor with nothing attached reports the -273 sentinel and is left out, as are the power-supply trip levels, which are not temperatures. %d zones were listed.

The kernel accounting over the window named in its dump. Load is the one, five and fifteen minute average; each row is the processor time that process used, and kernel workers appear because they do the work, not only apps.
